name: atm_take_cash
text: Standing in front of an ATM, lean slightly forward and reach the RIGHT hand into the waist-high cash slot, grip the banknotes, withdraw the RIGHT hand and bring the cash to the front of the abdomen. Finish holding the banknotes in the RIGHT hand at abdomen height, elbow bent comfortably down. The empty LEFT hand stays hanging beside the left thigh throughout. Do not exchange hands or drop the right arm at the end.
